Name: Akamaru Dog Replacer (CP) (Naruto)
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]This mod brings Akamaru from Naruto to Stardew Valley. :)

[img]https://abload.de/img/buttons1jtd.png[/img]﻿

1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Install the latest version of Content Patcher.
3. Download the mod anywhere and then unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.



[img]https://abload.de/img/button3bljhi.png[/img]

To uninstall, just delete it from the mods folder.

This will change the "dog" by default.
If you use "dog1" or "dog2" open the conent.json file with any text editing software.
Change the "dog" to "dog1" or "dog2" according to this:
[img]https://abload.de/img/dogsgjkzx.png[/img][/center]

Manifest.Name: Akamaru Dog Replacer
Manifest.Description: Replaces the dog with Akamaru from Naruto.
